 ASHEVILLE, N.C. (WLOS) — College Application Week is underway this week.
 College Application Week features free applications for N.C. high school seniors. (WLOS) 
 It's an opportunity for high school seniors to apply to 43 colleges and all 58 community colleges in our state for free.
 It opens at 7:30 a.m. on Monday (Oct. 19) and will close on Sunday (Oct. 25) at 5 p.m. The cost of college applications can quickly add up according to the host of the week, "College for North Carolina" (CFNC).
 EARLY VOTING SURGES IN BUNCOMBE COUNTY, 7,000+ BALLOTS CAST ON FIRST DAY 
 Last year, more than 25,000 student applicants took advantage of the opportunity to submit over 66,000 college applications through CFNC.
 “The ability to submit college applications for free, coupled with an improved and easy-to-complete FAFSA makes this the perfect time for students to apply," said Dan Harrision, Executive Director of the North Carolina State Education Assistance Authority (NCSEAA), the primary sponsor for CFNC.
 A full list of colleges waiving fees for most students is available at College for North Carolina website . 
 For adult learners, information is available by clicking here .
